methode: On 17 October 2026, the site team compared what lonodji.org publishes with what accountability standards expect of a non-governmental organisation: the Core Humanitarian Standard (2024 edition, nine commitments), the Global Standard for CSO Accountability (twelve commitments) and the Chadian framework the site cites (ordinance No. 023/PR/2018, decree No. 1917/PR/MEPD/2018). Each criterion points to the page that evidences it. The assessment covers what the site shows, not the association itself; it will be repeated every quarter.

criteres: Name, purpose, seat, history
Mission, History; national seat in N’Djamena, operations seat in Bédjondo
Legal basis shown as it stands
“Recognised in 1995 · current authorisation being verified”; the Procedures page explains the 2018 ordinance and the NGO decree
Authorisation (order or receipt) published
Being verified on the Documents page; it is the first document a donor or an administration asks for
Statutes and internal rules published
Forthcoming on the Documents page; the 1995 statutes have not been found, a revision is planned by the general assembly
Legal notice: publisher, host
Legal notice dated and corrected on 8 October 2026
Named governing bodies
Executive board with roles on the Mission page
Organisation chart and responsibilities
Six pillars, twenty-two themes and their coordinators
Register of decisions
One dated line per decision, appointment, announcement or proposal, with its source
General assembly minutes
Forthcoming; the board report of 18 September 2026 is published, its signed version is announced
Elections and mandates
Adopted procedure, timetable, rules for publishing candidates and results
Relaunch general assembly
Date set for Saturday 30 January 2027 (announced 18 October 2026); venue, agenda and notice still to be published
Conflicts of interest of office-holders
Policy drafted on 23 September 2026, not adopted; no declarations of interest
Bank account in the association’s name
“Fundraising suspended until an account is opened in the association’s name”: stated clearly, but blocking for any agreement
Annual accounts, budget
Announced from the first financial year; no financial figure on the site, consistent with the absence of an account
Sources of funds, membership fees
Membership fee mentioned, with no adopted scale and no amount collected
Call for donations, receipts
The Get involved page invites support; no receipt possible without an account
Donor programmes and open windows
Forty programmes surveyed at source, a summary note to attach to letters
Publication of funding received (IATI standard)
Not applicable while no funding is received; to be planned from the first agreement
Conflicts of interest, fraud and corruption, procurement, personal data, sexual exploitation and abuse
Five drafts of 23 September 2026 submitted to the executive board, not adopted, not published
Code of conduct for members and volunteers
No page; “Courage · Discipline · Heritage” are values, not a code
Safeguarding of children and vulnerable people
General commitment on the Accountability page, with no written procedure and no designated focal point
Personal data protection
Each form states what is asked, why and for how long; data controller and rights
Sacred sites and burial places never located
Rule applied on the map and in the village pages
Complaints mechanism, including anonymous, with appeal
Complaint form, appeal up to the general assembly
Measurable response commitment
Human reply within forty-eight working hours; compliance with this deadline is not yet reported publicly
Residents’ participation in priorities
Needs, census and proposal forms; the link between needs received and the seven priorities is not shown
Corrections log
Each error dated: what we wrote, what is correct, how we noticed
Report on messages received
Promise to answer everyone; no aggregate report (how many received, how many answered on time)
What the association does, where, for whom
Pillars, themes, territory map, diagnosis, needs
Promise kept apart from delivery
Tracking dashboard: advocacy files published and sent, commitments confirmed delivered; conditional tense throughout
Results for residents
“Changes for residents remain to be measured”; no completed action documented to date
Indicators with targets
Six indicators without targets, by rule: no target without a board decision
Alignment with the SDGs and donor categories
SDG page; titles of the twenty-two themes aligned (decision 2026-37, to be confirmed by the board)
Coordination with other actors
NGOs present are listed; no formal partnership
Crisis preparedness
“Disaster risk reduction and emergencies” theme without a plan

communication.titre: Transparency about the organisation and communication
criteres: Annual or activity report
Forthcoming; the quarterly magazine and the monthly letter partly stand in for it
Dated news and publications
News, monthly letter, magazine, press area
Verifiable figures
Counters generated from the data, generation date shown
Languages
Full French, English on the main pages; Arabic absent (drafts not reviewed); Nangnda lexicon
Accessibility
Accessibility statement, no violation found in the 5 October audit, site usable on 3G and offline
Roles and job descriptions
Coordination job descriptions, open positions
Training, supervision, evaluation
Nothing published; expected once activities are under way
Volunteer protection (insurance, consent)
To be handled with the integrity policies

pieces: Founding documents: authorisation in order, statutes and internal rules submitted to the general assembly, minutes
By 17 November 2026 for the draft texts (phase 2 of the timetable)
politiques: Adoption of the five integrity policies of 23 September; code of conduct for members and volunteers; safeguarding focal point
Executive board, then the site team
compte: Bank account in the association’s name, membership fee scale, then annual accounts
Before the relaunch general assembly of 30 January 2027
reponses: Quarterly report on messages received and the share answered within forty-eight hours, with no personal data
rapport: First activity report, built from the register, commitments, corrections and indicators
Close of the first financial year
